# Shape Burst

**Cover › Geometric** · v1.0.0 · 48 frames at 30 fps (24–90)

Rings of colour burst out from a point one after another until the last one covers the frame, then a hole bursts open the same way.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/shape-burst@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/shape-burst@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Energetic reveals
- Social and kids content
- Logo moments

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import shapeBurst from './transitions/04-cover/geometric/shape-burst';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(shapeBurst, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 48 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `colors` | colors | `["#111111","#F1EFEA","#FF4F1A"]` |  | Ring colours in order; the last one covers the frame, so make it the incoming scene's background colour. |
| `x` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Burst centre x. |
| `y` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Burst centre y. |
| `hold` | number | `0.1` | 0–0.4 | Share of the transition spent fully covered. |
